actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.encode_video.description: Requests a video encoding job on slashed.cloud.
actions.encode_video.props.callback.desc: Optional URL to receive a POST request when encoding completes. Slashed will send the result to this endpoint.
actions.encode_video.props.jobs.descript: Array of encoding job objects to apply to the source file. Each object must include a `type` field specifying the job type (e.g. `{ "type": "encode", "output": "output.mp4" }`).
actions.encode_video.props.priority.desc: Processing priority for this encoding request.
actions.encode_video.props.service_id.de: Your service ID from the slashed.cloud dashboard. Found under your service settings.
actions.encode_video.props.source.descri: Path or URL of the source video file in the storage you have configured for your service.
auth.description: Your Bearer Token from the slashed.cloud dashboard. Go to your service settings to find or generate it.
description: AV1 video encoding and transcoding via slashed.cloud.
